#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

class FastScanner {
private:
    FILE* sin;
    char buffer[1024];
    int ptr = 0;
    int buflen = 0;
    bool hasNextByte() {
        if (ptr < buflen) return true;
        ptr = 0;
        buflen = (int)fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), sin);
        if (buflen <= 0) return false;
        return true;
    }
    int readByte() {
        if (hasNextByte()) return buffer[ptr++];
        return -1;
    }
    static bool isPrintableChar(int c) { return 33 <= c && c <= 126; }
public:
    FastScanner() { sin = stdin; }
    FastScanner(const char* filename) { sin = fopen(filename, "r"); }
    bool hasNext() {
        while (hasNextByte() && !isPrintableChar(buffer[ptr])) ptr++;
        return hasNextByte();
    }
    string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw logic_error("NoSuchElement");
        stringstream sb;
        int b = readByte();
        while (isPrintableChar(b)) {
            sb << (char)b;
            b = readByte();
        }
        return sb.str();
    }
    ll longNext() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw logic_error("NoSuchElement");
        ll n = 0;
        bool minus = false;
        int b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            minus = true;
            b = readByte();
        }
        if (b < '0' || '9' < b) throw logic_error("NumberFormat");
        while (true) {
            if ('0' <= b && b <= '9') {
                n *= 10;
                n += b - '0';
            } else if (b == -1 || !isPrintableChar(b) || b == ':') {
                return minus ? -n : n;
            } else {
                throw logic_error("NumberFormat");
            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }
    int intNext() { return (int)longNext(); }
    double doubleNext() { return stod(next()); }
    vector<ll> nextLongArray(int n) {
        vector<ll> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = longNext();
        return a;
    }
    vector<int> nextIntArray(int n) {
        vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = intNext();
        return a;
    }
    vector<double> nextDoubleArray(int n) {
        vector<double> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = doubleNext();
        return a;
    }
};

struct FastWriter {
    stringstream out;
    FastWriter& p(const string& s) { out << s; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(const char* s) { out << s; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(char c) { out << c; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(int x) { out << x; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(long long x) { out << x; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(double x) { out << x; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(const string& format, const vector<const char*>&) { return *this; } // simplified
    template<typename... Args>
    FastWriter& pp(Args... args) {
        ((out << args << " "), ...);
        out << "\n";
        return *this;
    }
    void close() { cout << out.str(); }
};

FastScanner in;
FastWriter out;

ll min(ll a, ll b) { return a < b ? a : b; }

void solver() {
    ll n = in.intNext();
    vector<ll> ar = in.nextLongArray(3);
    vector<ll> br = in.nextLongArray(3);
    ll mxWins = 0;
    ll mxLosesOrDraw = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        mxWins += min(ar[i], br[(i + 1) % 3]);
        ll mxLose = min(br[i], ar[(i + 1) % 3]);
        ll mxDraw = min(br[i], ar[i]);
        mxLosesOrDraw += min(br[i], mxLose + mxDraw);
    }
    out.pp(n - mxLosesOrDraw, mxWins);
}

int main() {
    solver();
    out.close();
    return 0;
}
